{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import Text.Regex.TDFA ((=~))
import Text.Regex.TDFA.Text ()
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status403, status200, status400)

-- Multi-tenant configuration store
type TenantId = Text
data TenantConfig = TenantConfig
  { tenantName :: Text
  , allowedEmailPattern :: Text  -- Regex for allowed email domains
  , maxUsers :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

type TenantStore = IORef (Map.Map TenantId TenantConfig)

-- Default tenant configurations with email validation patterns
defaultTenants :: Map.Map TenantId TenantConfig
defaultTenants = Map.fromList
  [ ("tenant-alpha", TenantConfig "Alpha Corp" "^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+@alpha\\.com$" 100)
  , ("tenant-beta", TenantConfig "Beta Inc" "^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+@beta\\.org$" 50)
  ]

-- Normalize the pattern for consistent matching across tenants
-- This function ensures patterns work uniformly regardless of source
normalizePattern :: Text -> Text
normalizePattern pat =
  let stripped = T.strip pat
      -- Ensure anchoring for security
      anchored = if T.isPrefixOf "^" stripped then stripped
                 else T.append "^" stripped
      final = if T.isSuffixOf "$" anchored then anchored
              else T.append anchored "$"
  in final

-- Build composite pattern for tenant email validation
-- Allows tenant admins to add sub-domain patterns
buildValidationRegex :: TenantConfig -> Text -> Text
buildValidationRegex config additionalPattern =
  let basePattern = allowedEmailPattern config
      -- Combine base pattern with additional allowed pattern using alternation
      combined = if T.null additionalPattern
                 then basePattern
                 else T.concat ["(", basePattern, "|" , additionalPattern, ")"]
  in normalizePattern combined

-- Validate email against tenant's configured pattern
validateEmail :: Text -> Text -> Bool
validateEmail email pattern_ =
  let normalizedPattern = normalizePattern pattern_
  in (email :: Text) =~ (normalizedPattern :: Text) :: Bool

-- Check if user input matches the tenant's security policy
checkTenantAccess :: TenantStore -> TenantId -> Text -> Text -> IO Bool
checkTenantAccess store tid email extraPattern = do
  tenants <- readIORef store
  case Map.lookup tid tenants of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just config -> do
      let fullPattern = buildValidationRegex config extraPattern
      return $ validateEmail email fullPattern

-- Register a new custom domain pattern for a tenant
registerDomainPattern :: TenantStore -> TenantId -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
registerDomainPattern store tid newPattern = do
  tenants <- readIORef store
  case Map.lookup tid tenants of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Tenant not found"
    Just config -> do
      -- Security check: pattern must contain an @ symbol for email matching
      if not (T.isInfixOf "@" newPattern)
        then return $ Left "Pattern must be an email pattern (contain @)"
        else do
          let updated = config { allowedEmailPattern = buildValidationRegex config newPattern }
          modifyIORef store (Map.insert tid updated)
          return $ Right ()

-- Sanitize input to prevent obvious injection
sanitizeInput :: Text -> Text
sanitizeInput = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\0' && c /= '\n' && c /= '\r')

main :: IO ()
main = do
  store <- newIORef defaultTenants
  scotty 3000 $ do

    -- Endpoint: validate a user's email for tenant access
    post "/api/v1/tenant/:tid/validate" $ do
      tid <- param "tid"
      emailRaw <- param "email"
      extraPatternRaw <- param "extra_pattern" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
      let email = sanitizeInput (TL.toStrict emailRaw)
      let extraPattern = sanitizeInput (TL.toStrict extraPatternRaw)
      result <- liftIO $ checkTenantAccess store (TL.toStrict tid) email extraPattern
      if result
        then do
          status status200
          json (Map.fromList [("access" :: Text, "granted" :: Text)])
        else do
          status status403
          json (Map.fromList [("access" :: Text, "denied" :: Text)])

    -- Endpoint: register additional email domain pattern
    post "/api/v1/tenant/:tid/patterns" $ do
      tid <- param "tid"
      patternRaw <- param "pattern"
      let pat = sanitizeInput (TL.toStrict patternRaw)
      result <- liftIO $ registerDomainPattern store (TL.toStrict tid) pat
      case result of
        Left err -> do
          status status400
          json (Map.fromList [("error" :: Text, err)])
        Right () -> do
          status status200
          json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "registered" :: Text)])

    -- Endpoint: health check
    get "/health" $ do
      status status200
      text "OK"
